plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Synaccess SynLink / netBooter DU intelligent power distribution (SYNLINK-MIB, enterprise PEN 21728). It reports uptime, environment temperature and humidity, inlet current and voltage, and interface traffic.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Environment temperature of the Synaccess SynLink / netBooter DU in degrees Celsius, from sensorTemp (1.3.6.1.4.1.21728.4.7.1.1.3, Integer32 Celsius including offset). Absent rows are dropped.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Environment relative humidity of the Synaccess SynLink / netBooter DU in percent, from sensorHumidity (1.3.6.1.4.1.21728.4.7.1.1.4, Integer32 percent). Absent rows and values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: pdu_inlet_current_amps
metrics.description: Inlet RMS current of the Synaccess SynLink / netBooter DU in amperes, from inletCurrentRms (1.3.6.1.4.1.21728.4.2.1.1.17, Integer32 amps). Absent or negative values are dropped.

metrics.name: pdu_inlet_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Inlet RMS voltage of the Synaccess SynLink / netBooter DU in volts, from inletVoltageRms (1.3.6.1.4.1.21728.4.2.1.1.19, Integer32 volts). Absent or negative values are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
